sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 249995 (catx.py: 36 sites incl. the group shelter)
https://www.usbr.gov/gp/mtao/canyonferry/index.html (closures: Riverside, Hellgate, Court Sheriff, Cave Bay; none at White Earth)

values.note: 2026 peak season (May 1 - Sep 13) standard site $10; the rate table also carries a second standard-site rate of $20 without saying which sites it applies to. Group-use shelter (with 5 campsites) $90.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/249995/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-01 to 09-13: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 10, a second STANDARD NONELECTRIC template 20, GROUP SHELTER ELECTRIC 90; same 2025-2028), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for 249995 (all 35 campsites STANDARD NONELECTRIC; only the group shelter has power) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/249995 ('No electrical source for camp trailers or RVs is available at shelters.'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/249995 ('White Earth Campground has 36 designated campsites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'During the peak summer months services include vault toilets, potable water, trash, recycling containers and campground hosts.'
31 of the 35 campsites are reservable; 4 are first-come. 14 days in any rolling 30. Single sites take one camping unit (plus a children's tent); sites must be occupied each night.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/249995 (rules reservationWindow 6 Months, maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 days Rolling 30 Days; notices) + catalog (31 campsites reservable, 4 not), read 2026-10-22

note: Bureau of Reclamation campground on a peninsula of Canyon Ferry Reservoir east of Winston, 5.5 mi up Beaver Creek Rd; open valley between the Big Belt and Elkhorn ranges. Boat ramp with trailer parking; group-use shelter with 5 campsites. --Claude
summary: Recreation.gov (Reclamation's Canyon Ferry Field Office): confirmed $10 standard site, 36 sites, no electric, vault toilets, potable water (peak summer), rec.gov booking, 14-day limit. Added fcfs some_sites (4 first-come), 180-day window. Max rig length not catalogued; season not stated (the May 1 - Sep 13 rate season is not a season statement). No closure at White Earth (Reclamation's 2026 closures are at Riverside, Hellgate, Court Sheriff and Cave Bay). Note corrected ($8 -> the fee group's $10) and trimmed of restated values.
flags: Missing phone: recreation.gov gives (406) 475-3921 (facility) / (406) 475-3920 (contact); Reclamation's Canyon Ferry Field Office is (406) 475-3921.

Missing agency page: Reclamation has no White Earth page of its own; its Canyon Ferry facilities page (https://www.usbr.gov/gp/recreation/cfrrec.html) is dated 2019. Recreation.gov is the only current official page.
